intro.title: FlyMe2TheMoon Web Demo
intro.desc: Choose the landscape keyboard / gamepad edition or the new portrait touch edition. All 60 levels are included; progress and settings are shared in this browser on this website.

runtime.title: Live Demo
runtime.cover: Ready for the moon? Start the full game below.
runtime.temporary: Browser storage is unavailable. Progress will be lost when this page closes.
runtime.failed: The game could not start. Reload the page to try again.
runtime.controls: Click the game to focus. Space / W / Up: thrust; A / D: steer. Hold the mouse below the character to fly. P: pause; R: retry; Esc: back. Supported gamepads can also be used.
runtime.note: Requires WebGL 2. Tap the game to enable audio. Both editions share saves in this browser and website. Clearing site data removes saves. Run only one game tab at a time.
runtime.save_failed: Could not save. The game stays open; check browser storage and retry. Temporary progress cannot be transferred after storage fails.
runtime.touch_controls: Tap menus. Hold below Kiana and drag to fly; release to stop. Use the pause menu to retry or return.
